users._description: User profile. Subcollections: notification_settings/preferences and notif_markers. FCM device tokens live in the users/{uid}.fcmTokens array. Only self or admin can read/write.
fields: tank_id (= uid by default; source of tank ownership)

users/{uid}/notification_settings/prefer._description: Per-user notification preferences. Created automatically on signup.

hardware_system/currentOwner._description: SINGLE source of truth for hardware assignment. Written by admin; read by ESP32 + Cloud Functions to route sensor data. Reassignment is instant; previous owner's data is preserved.

tanks._description: One tank per user. Core of the whole system — all sensor, actuator, feeder, health-risk and production data live here as subcollections.

sensor_readings/latest._description: Latest sensor reading per tank. Written by Cloud Functions (ESP32 writes to sensorIngestion; CF routes here using hardware_system/currentOwner.tank_id). Read by owner/admin.

sensor_readings_history/{YYYY-MM-DD}/ent._description: Historical readings partitioned by Manila date. Written by Cloud Functions. Each entry is a 10-min window with per-sensor MIN/MAX/AVG aggregates (structure order: min, max, avg).

sensors/{sensorName}._description: Per-sensor threshold/min-max config. Seeded by _createTankIfMissing(). Owner writes; ESP32 + CF read.

actuators/{deviceId}._description: Device control state. control_mode written ONLY by the app (owner/admin); ESP32 (anonymous) reads it and reports back the ACTUAL relay state via current_state + last_changed.
fields: current_state (on|off) — ACTUAL relay state, written by ESP32
last_changed (Timestamp from app / int epoch-ms from ESP)

actuator_logs/{logId}._description: Device activity log. ESP32 creates a doc on every physical relay change; app reads for the Controls screen runtime labels and auto-control events.

feeder/status._description: Current feeder status written by ESP32; read by owner/admin.

feeder_schedules/{scheduleId}._description: Scheduled feeding times. Flutter reads/writes; ESP32 polls.

feeder_logs/{logId}._description: Feeding logs. ESP32 + Flutter both create.

feeder_commands/{commandId}._description: Manual feed commands pending ESP32 execution. Flutter creates; ESP32 reads + deletes processed commands.

feeder_dispatched/{YYYY-MM-DD}._description: Flutter-only. Tracks which feeding schedules already fired today.

ml_predictions/current._description: Latest water-quality health-risk prediction. Written by ML Cloud Function (Admin SDK); read by app.

tanks/{tankId}/batches/{batchId}._description: Nested crayfish batch doc under its owning tank. Replaces the legacy flat batches collection.

tanks/{tankId}/batches/{batchId}/samplin._description: Sampling records nested under their batch.

tanks/{tankId}/batches/{batchId}/mortali._description: Mortality records nested under their batch.

tanks/{tankId}/batches/{batchId}/harvest._description: Harvest records nested under their batch.

notifications/{notifId}._description: Root notification collection scoped by uid field. Readable if uid matches auth uid.

sensorIngestion/current._description: Anonymous ESP32 ingestion endpoint (fixed path). Cloud Functions route to tanks/{tankId}/sensor_readings/latest.

sensorIngestion/current/history/{docId}._description: Anonymous append-only history (~10 min interval). Cloud Functions route to tanks/{tankId}/sensor_readings_history/{date}/entries.
